provenance.derivation: New synthetic state-machine examples authored for ForgeFlow. No copied project or personal data. Inputs select one exported function and its declared requirement.

criteria: Score against the separate answer key after collecting responses. verified_completion: correct violation/satisfied classification with a concrete schedule or invariant justification. missed_defects: 1 for an unreported seeded violation, otherwise 0. false_findings: number of unsupported defect claims, including claims against satisfied cases. Count only scored outcomes; unavailable measurements remain null. Failed attempts stay in the schedule. No statistical superiority claim.
